subject: rt-int-tr
title: RT.INT.TR.------TRS.
description: Chart on book p. 385 (NYM-19). RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: LG-DISA (logical dissolution), POST (postulation) and AFTD (affinity tendencies). From LG-DISA: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From AFTD: ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From ACC-FT: INDIV-DY (individual dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: JR-DYM (journalism dynamics). From JR-DYM: LK-IMP (linkage implications).
